trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: آمَنَّا بِاللهِ وَكَفَرْنَا بِالْجِبْتِ وَالطَّاغُوْتِ آمَنَّا بِمَنْ لَا يَمُوْتُ آمَنَّا بِمَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْاَرَضِيْنَ وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ وَالنُّجُوْمَ وَالْجِبَالَ وَالشَّجَرَ وَالدَّوَابَ وَخَلَقَ الْجِنَّ وَالْاِنْسَ آمَنَّا بِمَا اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْنَا وَاُنْزِلَ اِلَيْكُمْ وَاِلَهُنَا وَاِلَهُكُمْ وَاحِدٌ وَنَحْنُ لَهٗ مُسْلِمُوْنَ۔

lines.rarabic: AA-MANNAA BIL-LAAHE WA KAFAR-NAA BIL-JIBTE WATTAA-GHOOTE AA-MANNAA BE-MAN LAA YAMOO-TO AA-MANNAA BE-MAN KHALA-QAS SAMAA-WAATE WAL-ARA-ZEENA WASH-SHAMSA WAL-QAMARA WAN-NOJOO-MA WAL-JEBAA-LA WASH-SHAJARA WAD-DAWAA-BA WA KHALA-QAL JINNA WAL-INSA AA-MANNAA BE-MAA UNZE-LA ILAIY-NAA WA UNZE-LA ILAIY-KUM WA ILA-HONAA WA ILAHO-KUM WAAHE-DOON WA NAHNO LAHU MUSLE-MOONA.

trans.en: We believe in God. We denounce sorcery and evil! We believe in Him who shall not perish! We believe in Him who created the heavens, the earths, the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees and the quadrupeds: He who created the genies (Jinn) and the men. We believe in the revelation which has come down to us and in that which came down to you; Our Allah and your Allah is one; and it is to Him we bow (in Islam).
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: آمَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَارُوْنَ وَمُوْسٰى‌، آمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوْحِ، آمَنَّا بِاللهِ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ آمَنَّا بِمَنْ اَنْشَاَ السَّحَابَ وَخَلَقَ الْعِبَادَ وَالْعَذَابَ وَالْعِقَابَ، آمَنَّا آمَنَّا آمَنَّا آمَنَّا آمَنَّا آمَنَّا آمَنَّا بِاللهِ رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوْبَنَا بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَتَجَاوَزْ عَنِّيْ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ۔

lines.rarabic: AA-MANNAA BE-RABBE HAAROONA WA MOOSAA, AA-MANNAA BE-RABBIL MALAA-E-KATE WAR-ROOHE, AA-MANNAA BIL LAAHE WAHDA-HU LAA SHAREE-KA LAHU AA-MANNAA BE-MAN AN-SHA-AS-SAHAA-BA WA KHALA-QAL E’BAADA WAL-A’ZAABA WAL-E’QAABA, AA-MANNAA, AA-MANNAA, AA-MANNAA, AA-MANNAA, AA-MANNAA, AA-MANNAA, AA-MANNAA BIL-LAAHE TABBA-NAGH-FIR LANAA ZONOO-BANAA BE-HAQQE MOHAMMADIW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN WA TAJAA-WAZ A’NNEE INNA-KA ANTAL GHAFOO-RUR RAHEEMO.

trans.en: We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses. We believe in the Lord of the angels and the Spirit. We believe in God for whom there are no partners. We believe in Him who brings forth the Reckoning, created torture and punishment! We believe. We believe. We believe. We believe. We believe. We believe in God. O Lord forgive us for the sake of Muhammad (s.a.w.a) and his progeny (a.s) surely you are most gracious and merciful overlook our mistakes for surely you are most forgiving.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
